policy: Readable source differences remain separate. Authority may resolve a general rule without rewriting lower-authority component wording; unresolved conflicts never receive a default.

conflicts.title: Search keep optionality and unchosen destination
conflicts.difference: Card says may keep 1 / discard the rest; rulebook says pick 1, put unchosen cards on respective deck bottoms, and do not reveal them.
conflicts.resolution: Official-primary rulebook controls the general Search procedure; exact card wording remains a source variant.

conflicts.title: Rest Uninfected/non-Infected wording and destination
conflicts.difference: Reviewed face says remove all Uninfected; Medical Support variant says remove non-Infected instead of discarding; ordinary Infection Procedure discards all Contaminations.
conflicts.resolution: Each component variant is retained. Pilot composes the reviewed face as a destination override over the official Procedure.

conflicts.title: Exploration Entrance Noise versus universal Movement Noise
conflicts.difference: Noise is mandatory after every Movement; Entrance Effect is called additional; the worked example resolves one Entrance Noise and then finishes.
conflicts.resolution: No default; explicit alternatives in review-gates.json.

conflicts.title: Duck and Cover multiple replacement targets
conflicts.difference: Card says the other Character but gives no selection/tie-break when more than one other Character is present.
conflicts.resolution: No default; explicit alternatives in review-gates.json.

conflicts.title: Event placement at an undiscovered Nest
conflicts.difference: Event requires placement in the Nest; checked sources do not define placement when the Nest Room is absent.
conflicts.resolution: No default; Event impossible-sentence rule is one candidate, not silently adopted.

conflicts.title: Player Help phase sequence versus current rulebook
conflicts.difference: TTS Player Help fronts encode an obsolete phase sequence and 10-card count while the official current rulebook controls base sequence/count.
conflicts.resolution: Retain TTS as source-version evidence; never alias same words to current semantics.

conflicts.title: FACILITY RESTART unreadable exact-source span
conflicts.difference: Prototype exact source ends “Systems must be” with no recoverable following mark; other variants differ materially.
conflicts.resolution: Keep source blocked; no semantic record may invent or borrow the missing mark.

conflicts.title: Supply Room optional keep cardinality
conflicts.difference: Printed “You may keep 2” does not unambiguously state optional exact-two versus any subset up to two.
conflicts.resolution: No default; explicit alternatives in review-gates.json.
